```yaml
name: Performance Benchmark

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  benchmark:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    concurrency:
      group: ${{ github.ref }}
      cancel-in-progress: true

    steps:
    - name: Checkout PR and main branches
      uses: actions/checkout@v2
      with:
        fetch-depth: 0

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '16'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm install

    - name: Build PR branch
      env:
        BRANCH: pr
      run: |
        mkdir -p ./pr_branch
        git worktree add ./pr_branch HEAD~1
        cd ./pr_branch
        npm run build --if-present

    - name: Build main branch
      env:
        BRANCH: main
      run: |
        mkdir -p ./main_branch
        git worktree add ./main_branch origin/main
        cd ./main_branch
        npm run build --if-present

    - name: Run benchmark
      id: benchmark
      run: |
        function runBenchmark(branch) {
          echo "Running ${branch} benchmark..."
          cd ./${branch}_branch
          npm run bench --if-present -- --warmup=2 --measure=5
        }

        runBenchmark(pr)
        runBenchmark(main)

        echo "::set-output name=pr_time::$(jq -r '.results[0].time' < results.json)"
        echo "::set-output name=main_time::$(jq -r '.results[0].time' < ../main_branch/results.json)"

    - name: Calculate time difference
      id: diff
      run: |
        pr_time=${{ steps.benchmark.outputs.pr_time }}
        main_time=${{ steps.benchmark.outputs.main_time }}
        diff=$(echo "$pr_time - $main_time" | bc)
        percent_diff=$(echo "scale=2; ($diff / $main_time) * 100" | bc)
        echo "::set-output name=time_diff::${diff}s"
        echo "::set-output name=percent_diff::${percent_diff}%"

    - name: Post comment
      if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
      run: |
        pr_number=${{ github.event.number }}
        comment="\
        <details><summary>Performance Benchmark</summary>\
        \
        | | Time |\
        |---|---:|\
        | PR branch | ${{ steps.benchmark.outputs.pr_time }}s |\
        | main branch | ${{ steps.benchmark.outputs.main_time }}s |\
        | **Diff** | **${{ steps.diff.outputs.time_diff }} (${{ steps.diff.outputs.percent_diff }}%)** |\
        \
        </details>"
        gh api "repos/${{ github.repository }}/issues/${pr_number}/comments" -X POST -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3+json" -d "{\"body\": \"$comment\"}"
```
